items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: I don't think I know him.

ctx.x: I don't know who Vermilla is. I don't know who Vermilla is. I asked him who Vermilla is. We talked about him earlier. V-Vernimilla? Vermilla is all the names. Permilla, Vermilla?
Who is Vermilla? Vermilla. Vermilla? Yeah. I don't think I know him. He said you talk about him once. I don't know him. I don't know him. Vermilla.
